feedback.problem: Find the characteristic equation of the matrix $N=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 3 \\ 3 & -1\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,N-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
N-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}-2-\lambda  & 3 \\ 3 & -1-\lambda \end{aligned}].
$$

Then, the characteristic equation is

$$
\begin{aligned}det(N-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}-2-\lambda  & 3 \\ 3 & -1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (-2-\lambda )(-1-\lambda )-3\cdot 3 & =0 \\ 2+2\lambda +\lambda +{\lambda }^{2}-9 & =0 \\ {\lambda }^{2}+3\lambda -7 & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
